author: SciShow
description:
Smoking is bad. We know this. But... there's one disease that seems to like it. As in, smokers are way less likely to get it. Here's the weird story about why smoking can keep ulcerative colitis at bay, and how we're using that knowledge to make a smoke-free treatment plan for UC.

Hosted by: Hank Green (he/him)
